# hermes-trove v1.1.4

Lossless Context Management for Hermes: install/uninstall automation, slash commands enabled by default, and multi-process WAL hardening.

## Highlights

- Install and uninstall scripts (`scripts/install.sh`, `scripts/uninstall.sh`): idempotent plugin + skill symlinks, config wiring, `.env` slash-command toggle.
- Slash commands (`/trove status|recall|store|forget|grep|compact|health|config|rotate`) enabled with `TROVE_ENABLE_SLASH_COMMAND=1`.
- Watchdog and lifecycle fixes: faster WS dead-socket rebuild, gate to 09:10–16:00 market hours.

## Changes

- Startup index self-heal: `integrity_check` at store open with in-place REINDEX for index-only b-tree damage (multi-process WAL split-brain class, Sep 2026 incident).
- Transient lock-contention retry on per-turn and tool-call ingest; corruption and disk I/O errors are never retried.
- Stale `-shm` sidecar cleanup only unlinks a proven-orphaned regular file: open-fd scan across `/proc/*/fd`, `lstat` + single-link check, so symlinked/hardlinked sidecars always fall through to the storage-permission validator.
- All tests green: 3183 passed, 12 xfailed.
